ssh.Name: ssh
ssh.description: Run shell or execute a command on a remote SSH node

-1.description: Forces ssh to try protocol version 1 only

-2.description: Forces ssh to try protocol version 2 only

-4.description: Forces ssh to use IPv4 addresses only

-6.description: Forces ssh to use IPv6 addresses only

-A.Name: -A
-A.description: Enables forwarding of the authentication agent connection

-C.Name: -C
-C.description: Requests compression of all data (including stdin, stdout, stderr, and data for forwarded X11 and TCP connections)

-D.Name: -D
-D.description: Specifies a local 'dynamic' application-level port forwarding

-F.Name: -F
-F.description: Specifies an alternative per-user configuration file

-I.Name: -I
-I.description: Specify the PKCS#11 shared library ssh should use to communicate with a PKCS#11 token providing the user's private RSA key

-K.Name: -K
-K.description: Enables GSSAPI-based authentication and forwarding (delegation) of GSSAPI credentials to the server

-L.Name: -L
-L.description: Specifies that the given port on the local (client) host is to be forwarded to the given host and port on the remote side

-M.Name: -M
-M.description: Places the ssh client into ``master'' mode for connection sharing

-N.Name: -N
-N.description: Do not execute a remote command

-O.Name: -O
-O.description: Control an active connection multiplexing master process

-R.Name: -R
-R.description: Specifies that the given port on the remote (server) host is to be forwarded to the given host and port on the local side

-S.Name: -S
-S.description: Specifies the location of a control socket for connection sharing, or the string 'none' to disable connection sharing

-V.Name: -V
-V.description: Display the version number and exit

-W.Name: -W
-W.description: Requests that standard input and output on the client be forwarded to host on port over the secure channel

-a.Name: -a
-a.description: Disables forwarding of the authentication agent connection

-b.Name: -b
-b.description: Use bind_address on the local machine as the source address of the connection

-c.Name: -c
-c.description: Selects the cipher specification for encrypting the session

-e.Name: -e
-e.description: Sets the escape character for sessions with a pty (default: '~')

-f.Name: -f
-f.description: Requests ssh to go to background just before command execution

-g.Name: -g
-g.description: Allows remote hosts to connect to local forwarded ports

-i.Name: -i
-i.description: Selects a file from which the identity (private key) for public key authentication is read

-k.Name: -k
-k.description: Disables forwarding (delegation) of GSSAPI credentials to the server

-l.Name: -l
-l.description: Specifies the user to log in as on the remote machine

-m.Name: -m
-m.description: Additionally, for protocol version 2 a comma-separated list of MAC (message authentication code) algorithms can be specified in order of preference

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Redirects stdin from /dev/null (actually, prevents reading from stdin)

-o.Name: -o
-o.description: Can be used to give options in the format used in the configuration file

-p.Name: -p
-p.description: Port to connect to on the remote host

-q.Name: -q
